event.title: Tasklet released Android texting support
event.summary: Tasklet just launched Android texting support for Tasklet.

sourcePreview.title: We just launched Android texting support for Tasklet. You can now text with your agent directly from your Android phone. Just ask it to "contact me via my phone number".
